native_LF.34: - **Employees** (§5). The employer withholds monthly advances. An employee with only §5 income from Slovak employers can ask an employer for the annual settlement (ročné zúčtovanie) by 15 February 2027 instead of filing (§38(1)). Otherwise they file DPFO type A.
